summary: 0 of 3 PRD seeds verified. No two named, reachable sources disagree on any of them today. Do not seed any of them through desk_ask.

seeds.fact: Closing time of the Recreation Park pickleball courts
seeds.question: What closing time is on the posted sign?
seeds.askWindow: Daylight, any day 8 AM–6 PM, while the Checkout Building is staffed. Most people are on site Sat–Sun 9 AM–12 PM during the 3.0 drop-in.

sourceA.name: rec.us, Recreation Park Courts
sourceA.says: Open 8 AM–10 PM. On all eight pickleball courts, the last bookable slot is 9–10 PM, seven days a week (court records updated Sep 22). The page renders client-side, so the text was read from its public API: https://api.rec.us/v1/locations/7527b987-0f0b-473e-9680-0c90758f6dcd

sourceB.name: City of El Segundo Recreation & Parks, pickleball page
sourceB.says: Gives no court closing time. Its league schedule runs until 10 PM on Mondays, which fits rec.us. No city page opened today says 9 PM.
sourceB.quote: All gender plays on Monday nights 7:00pm-10:00pm.

alsoChecked.name: elsegundorecparks.gov, Park & Facilities Reservations
alsoChecked.says: No hours. Court rentals are auto-approved, and it points to ESREC.org, which redirects to rec.us.
alsoChecked.quote: Rental requests for tennis, paddle tennis, pickleball, and racquetball courts are automatically approved

alsoChecked.name: elsegundorecparks.gov, Recreation Park directory entry
alsoChecked.says: Lists Pickleball as an amenity. No hours.

alsoChecked.name: elsegundo.gov, Court Reservation service entry
alsoChecked.says: A one-line link to the reservations page. No hours.

alsoChecked.name: El Segundo city-published 'Recreation Court Report' document
alsoChecked.says: Search snippets say it lists 8:00am–10:00pm, 7 days. Not opened: it returns 403 to fetch and downloads as a file in a browser.

alsoChecked.name: Places2Play (old listing)
alsoChecked.says: Returns 404 today. On Sep 28 it said reservable 8am–9pm; that text is gone. The new listing has no hours: https://www.places2play.org/places/fd69f966a8db

seeds.note: The 9 PM figure came from the old Places2Play text and a search-engine summary, both captured Sep 28. Neither is live now. The only 9 PM vs 8 PM split in our data is at Manhattan Heights, where both lines are on one manhattanbeach.gov page and the 8 PM line sits in the tennis reservation block, so it fails the two-source rule too. As a result, the Bet 5 letter's line "Your pages say 9 and 10 PM" is not supported today, and the letter should not be sent on that basis. The question stays drafted in case the posted sign at the court says something else.

seeds.fact: When the Manhattan Middle School courts are open to the public
seeds.question: Which days does the posted sign allow public play?
seeds.askWindow: Sat or Sun 8–11 AM, when every source agrees the gate is open. Don't ask on a weekday school morning: the live 'Gate's locked' answer already covers the Oct 2 Court Call.

sourceA.name: City of Manhattan Beach, Tennis, Pickleball, Paddle Tennis
sourceA.says: Public on Sat–Sun and on MBUSD breaks and holidays, 8 AM to dusk. It lists no weekday school-day hours.
sourceA.quote: open to the public on weekends and MBUSD breaks and holidays

sourceB.name: Pickleheads (credits the City of Manhattan Beach)
sourceB.says: Agrees with the city. The PRD's source B, the Friday 7:30 AM Court Call, is PointCast's own plan, not a source.
sourceB.quote: Schedule: Open on weekends, school breaks and holidays

alsoChecked.name: tennispickleballcalifornia.com
alsoChecked.says: Agrees: Sat–Sun and MBUSD breaks, 8 AM to dusk. Closed to the public Mon–Fri. The 'Mon–Fri 4 PM–dusk' claim from the Sep 28 pass is not on this page or any other page opened today.
alsoChecked.quote: MBUSD Breaks and Holidays 8:00 AM – Dusk

alsoChecked.name: MBUSD 2026-27 approved calendar (linked from mbusd.org)
alsoChecked.says: Fri Oct 2 is a regular school day. The only October holiday is Fri Oct 16. Also: Veterans Day Wed Nov 11; Thanksgiving recess Nov 23–27; winter recess Dec 21–Jan 1.

seeds.note: Every named source agrees. The conflict is with our own plan: Court Call 1 (Fri Oct 2, 7:30 AM) falls on an MBUSD school day and before the 8 AM opening, so no published window covers it. Fri Oct 16 is an MBUSD local holiday, when the city lists public play from 8 AM. A Court Call at 8 AM that Friday would fall inside published hours, and 7:30 still would not. Mike's word counts as a source only for seed 3, so it cannot verify this one. If a crew finds the gate open on a school morning, that report is the second source, and this seed can be re-run then. The existing courts.sign desk kind already asks this question; it lacks the 'No sign' answer.

seeds.fact: Days and times of the El Segundo advanced drop-in
seeds.question: Drop-in running right now?
seeds.askWindow: Mon 5–7 PM or Fri 9 AM–12 PM (the rec.us advanced sessions). A Thu 6–9 PM check would test the retired Places2Play claim.

sourceA.name: Mike, on site
sourceA.says: Advanced drop-in runs Mon 5–7 PM and Fri 9 AM–12 PM.

sourceB.name: Places2Play, El Segundo Recreation & Parks (new listing)
sourceB.says: No drop-in days or times. The Thu 6–9 PM / Sat 9 AM–12 PM text is gone, and the old URL (https://www.places2play.org/place?id=8235) returns 404. It points readers to esrec.org for drop-in info.
sourceB.quote: Three levels of drop in programs are available - Advanced, intermediate, novice.

alsoChecked.name: rec.us, Drop-in Pickleball program
alsoChecked.says: Matches Mike: Advanced Mon 5–7 PM ($5) and Fri 9 AM–12 PM ($7) for September and October. No Thursday drop-in. Sat 9 AM–12 PM is the 3.0 drop-in. API: https://api.rec.us/v1/programs/501e4d7f-d81f-461c-9746-6baa9458a9e1

seeds.note: The sources agree now. Mike and rec.us match, and Places2Play no longer makes the Thu/Sat claim; its Sat 9–12 slot may have been the 3.0 drop-in. One disagreement is left: Places2Play names a 'novice' drop-in level, but rec.us lists only Advanced, 3.0 and 3.5. That can't be settled at the fence in one tap, so it isn't a seed. Even if it verified, 'Drop-in running right now?' is a live observation, and the desk spec allows only stable sign facts, so it would need a spec change first.

schedule.notes: rec.us has one Drop-in Pickleball program with 8 active sections, all in September or October: Advanced Mon 5–7 PM (Sep 7–28, Oct 5–26), Advanced Fri 9 AM–12 PM (Sep 4–25, Oct 2–30), 3.0 Sat–Sun 9 AM–12 PM (Sep 5–27, Oct 3–31) and 3.5 Sat–Sun 3–5 PM (Sep 5–27, Oct 3–31). There is no November section, and searching the org page for 'drop' finds no other pickleball drop-in. The city pickleball page lists leagues only, with no drop-in dates. Sections are now one per month instead of 'September/October'; the from/until dates in courts-schedule.json still match. The last published sessions are Mon Oct 26, Fri Oct 30 and Sat Oct 31, and Sun Nov 1 has none. The October 3.0 and 3.5 sections were published Sep 16, and resident registration opened Sep 22–25 across the four sections. If November follows that pattern (an inference, nothing is published), its sections would appear by mid-October with resident registration around Oct 20–27. Re-check the program API on Oct 15.

sideFindings: rec.us answers the El Segundo parking ask: "Free parking is available in the parking lots on Pine and Sheldon, or Grand and Eucalyptus." (https://api.rec.us/v1/locations/7527b987-0f0b-473e-9680-0c90758f6dcd, gettingThereInfo).
Places2Play tags El Segundo 'Lighted Courts' (third party). No first-party page states lights. The 10 PM hours and the Monday league until 10 PM suggest lights but don't prove them.
